name: QuanBench Plus
description: QuanBench Plus is a unified multi-framework benchmark for evaluating large language models on quantum code generation tasks across Qiskit, Pennylane, and Cirq. It covers 42 tasks in quantum algorithms, gate decomposition, and state preparation, with automated grading using Pass@k functional evaluation and KL-divergence for probabilistic outputs.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark from the quantum-LLM literature, with emerging interest but not yet broad community adoption.
notes: Functional correctness is prioritized over circuit similarity; fidelity is excluded from primary scoring.
